title: Hungary Moves Closer to Shutting Down Its Sole Nuclear Plant
summary: Hungary may need to shut its sole nuclear power plant as soon as this weekend after the Danube River’s water level continued to drop, Prime Minister Peter Magyar said.

title: Australian gold medallists celebrate record-breaking day to close Commonwealth Games athletics program
summary: A 76-year record has fallen after Australia’s track and field athletes saved their best for last.

title: Family of young mother who died after missed UTI speak out for first time
summary: Gia Lam gave birth to her son and was dead three days later. A coronial inquest found her death was preventable. Her family are now breaking their silence.

title: CWG August 1 wrap: Record boxing haul powers India to fourth in medal standings
summary: India at Commonwealth Games, August 1: India climbed to fourth in the Commonwealth Games medal standings after a record-breaking boxing campaign yielded seven golds. Gulveer Singh scripted history in athletics, while judokas and para athletes also added to India's memorable day in Glasgow.

title: Heat wave bringing record-breaking temps, heightened wildfire risk to parts of Western US
summary: Dangerous heat was hitting parts of the Western U.S. this weekend, prompting warnings for people to stay inside and heightening wildfire risks in many areas. A high-pressure ridge is holding heat close to the ground from Arizona to Montana. Meteorologists say the good news is that it will be relatively short-lived. The National Weather Service on Saturday forecast a high of 115 degrees Fahrenheit (46 degrees Celsius) in Las Vegas, 116F (47C) in Phoenix and a record 118F (48C) in El Centro, California. Great Falls, Montana, was expected to hit a record 104F (40C).
